intro: Step-In L Shoe Cabinet brings wall-mounted efficiency to shoe storage. Designed to hold eight pairs across four levels, it keeps footwear organised while occupying minimal floor space in your entryway.

features.title: Wall-mounted space-saving design
features.text: Crafted from high quality CRCA steel construct, the Step-In shoe cabinet mounts directly to your wall using tear-drop holes, eliminating floor space requirements. This suspended installation keeps entryways open and uncluttered, making even compact spaces feel more spacious and organised.

features.title: Eight-pair storage capacity
features.text: Four levels with two-pair capacity per level accommodate eight pairs of shoes comfortably. This sizing suits small to medium households, providing adequate storage without overwhelming your entryway with bulky furniture.

features.title: Linked door mechanism for convenience
features.text: All compartment doors connect together for simultaneous opening and closing with a single motion. This synchronised mechanism eliminates the hassle of opening multiple doors individually, making shoe access quick and effortless during busy mornings.

features.title: Central locking security
features.text: A single lock secures all four compartments simultaneously, protecting your footwear collection. This central locking feature provides peace of mind in shared living situations or homes with curious children, keeping shoes safely stored.

features.title: Built-in ventilation system
features.text: Strategic ventilation openings allow continuous air circulation through each compartment. This airflow prevents moisture buildup and odour accumulation.

care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
